title: Web Development Fundamentals
description: Master modern HTML5, CSS3, responsive design principles, and vanilla JavaScript to build clean, fast, and accessible websites.
descriptionAr: إتقان تقنيات HTML5 وCSS3 الحديثة ومبادئ التصميم المتجاوب وجافاسكريبت لبناء مواقع سريعة وشاملة وسهلة الوصول.
outcomes: Structure semantic accessible HTML documents adhering to WCAG standards
Design flexible responsive multi-breakpoint layouts using CSS Grid and Flexbox
Implement client-side interactivity, DOM manipulation, and asynchronous APIs using Vanilla JS
Deploy production-grade static websites with version control best practices

title: Python for Data & Problem Solving
description: Learn algorithmic thinking, object-oriented programming, and practical data structures using the versatile Python language.
descriptionAr: تعلم التفكير الخوارزمي والبرمجة كائنية التوجه وتراكيب البيانات العملية باستخدام لغة بايثون متعددة الاستخدامات.
outcomes: Understand core computational concepts, algorithms, and OOP paradigms
Manipulate tabular datasets, parse structured JSON, and handle file I/O
Build modular CLI tools, automated scripts, and data visualizers
Apply defensive programming and unit testing principles

title: Applied Calculus & Linear Algebra
description: Develop rigorous mathematical reasoning through multivariable calculus, matrix transformations, and their applications in modern computing.
descriptionAr: تطوير التفكير الرياضي الدقيق من خلال حساب التفاضل والتكامل متعدد المتغيرات وتحويلات المصفوفات وتطبيقاتها التقنية.
outcomes: Perform vector operations, eigenvalues, and matrix factorizations
Evaluate partial derivatives, gradient vectors, and optimization surfaces
Formulate mathematical models for engineering and algorithmic systems
Apply analytic and numerical solving techniques

title: Modern Arabic Rhetoric & Composition
titleAr: البلاغة والإنشاء في اللغة العربية الحديثة
description: Refine rhetorical expression, academic writing eloquence, and syntactic accuracy across classical and contemporary Arabic literature.
descriptionAr: صقل مهارات البلاغة والبيان والكتابة الأكاديمية وصحة التراكيب النحوية في سياقات الأدب العربي الحديث والتقليدي.
outcomes: Compose persuasive academic and professional essays with precision
Analyze rhetorical figures of speech, semantic nuance, and poetic meter
Master advanced syntactic parsing and punctuation conventions
Critique contemporary journalistic and literary prose
prerequisites: Intermediate reading and writing fluency in Arabic

title: Foundational Classical & Quantum Physics
description: Investigate physical mechanics, thermodynamics, wave equations, and introductory quantum principles with hands-on laboratory inquiry.
descriptionAr: استكشاف الميكانيكا الكلاسيكية والديناميكا الحرارية ومعادلات الموجات ومقدمة نظرية الكم عبر التجارب المعملية الاستقصائية.
outcomes: Model Newtonian mechanics, kinematic trajectories, and momentum conservation
Quantify thermal equilibrium, entropy, and thermodynamic work
Interpret electromagnetic spectra and wave-particle duality concepts
Conduct empirical laboratory measurements and propagate uncertainties
prerequisites: Secondary school algebra and basic trigonometry

title: Graphic Design & Visual Communication
description: Explore color theory, typographic hierarchy, composition grids, and brand asset crafting for digital and print media.
descriptionAr: استكشاف نظرية الألوان، التدرج الطباعي، شبكات التكوين، وتصميم هويات العلامات التجارية للوسائط الرقمية والمطبوعة.
outcomes: Construct visual hierarchy through intentional scale, contrast, and alignment
Apply harmonious color schemes that meet accessibility contrast ratios
Select and pair Latin and Arabic typographic font families thoughtfully
Design comprehensive brand identity guidelines and digital design collateral
prerequisites: No prior design software experience required

title: Academic Writing & Research Methods
description: Synthesize scholarly sources, construct logical argumentative frameworks, and adhere to publication citation standards.
descriptionAr: توليف المصادر العلمية، بناء الأطر الجدلية المنطقية، والالتزام بمعايير التوثيق والنشر الأكاديمي العالمية.
outcomes: Formulate robust research hypotheses and structured thesis statements
Execute peer-reviewed literature reviews and source syntheses
Master APA and MLA citation protocols to maintain academic integrity
Draft concise, peer-review-ready scientific research manuscripts
prerequisites: Intermediate English proficiency (CEFR B2 or equivalent)

title: Executive Business Communication
description: Sharpen persuasive stakeholder pitching, diplomatic negotiation techniques, and boardroom presentation fluency.
descriptionAr: صقل مهارات العرض والإقناع أمام أصحاب المصلحة، تقنيات التفاوض الدبلوماسي، والتحدث المؤسسي المؤثر.
outcomes: Deliver structured executive briefings and concise business memos
Navigate cross-cultural negotiations with diplomatic precision
Design compelling data-driven executive slide decks
Manage critical crisis communications with composure

title: Digital Growth & Analytics Strategy
description: Understand omnichannel acquisition funnels, search engine optimization (SEO), performance marketing, and conversion telemetry.
descriptionAr: فهم مسارات اكتساب العملاء متعددة القنوات، تحسين محركات البحث، التسويق القائم على الأداء وقياس التحويلات الرقمية.
outcomes: Construct conversion funnels from awareness to customer retention
Audit technical and on-page SEO metrics using modern diagnostic tools
Run targeted performance marketing campaigns with budget discipline
Synthesize analytics data into strategic executive growth dashboards
prerequisites: Basic web and social media familiarity

modules.title: Module 1: Search Architecture & Technical SEO
modules.titleAr: الوحدة 1: بنية محركات البحث والـ SEO التقني
lessons: Core Web Vitals Impact on Ranking

title: Foundations of Chemical Equilibrium & Organic Synthesis
description: Examine atomic orbital geometry, chemical reaction kinetics, thermodynamics of equilibrium, and organic reaction mechanisms.
descriptionAr: دراسة هندسة المدارات الذرية، حركية التفاعلات الكيميائية، ديناميكا التوازن، وآليات تفاعلات الكيمياء العضوية.
outcomes: Predict molecular geometry using VSEPR and hybridization models
Calculate reaction rates, equilibrium constants, and activation energies
Diagram nucleophilic and electrophilic reaction mechanisms
Operate laboratory titration and spectroscopy apparatus safely

title: Data Modeling & Analytical Insights
description: Transform messy raw datasets into decision-grade reports using dynamic formulas, pivot tables, and statistical validation.
descriptionAr: تحويل البيانات الأولية إلى تقارير استراتيجية داعمة للقرار باستخدام الصيغ الديناميكية والجداول المحورية والتحليل الإحصائي.
outcomes: Cleanse and transform unstructured datasets using automated data tools
Deploy complex lookup, logic, and multi-criteria array formulas
Construct interactive analytical dashboards with drill-down slicers
Apply descriptive statistical measures to validate trends

title: Formal Logic & Critical Inquiry
description: Analyze deductive validity, expose informal cognitive fallacies, and develop disciplined dialectical problem-solving habits.
descriptionAr: تحليل صحة الاستدلال الاستنباطي، كشف المغالطات المنطقية المعرفية، وتطوير عادات التفكير المنهجي والجدلي.
outcomes: Diagram propositional truth tables and validate syllogistic forms
Identify over 25 common informal cognitive and argumentative fallacies
Structure persuasive philosophical and analytical debates
Make sound decisions under cognitive bias and incomplete information

modules.title: Module 2: Dialectics & Fallacy Detection
lessons: Ad Hominem, Straw Man & False Dilemmas

modules.title: Module 3: Ethical Reasoning & Argumentation
lessons: Discourse Ethics in the Digital Age
